network_only: GPT web tool plus curl/jq for Tavily/Exa and the existing native Codex CLI; no Python, Node, compilation or local model inference on the login node
slurm_only: All Python, normalization, scoring, wrapper CLI, source validation and archival checks
collection: Same frozen fifteen queries, one first-pass sample per query and engine; no successful answer selectively retried
codex: Identical prompt/flags to the frozen probe script, 90 second timeout, low reasoning effort, groups of eight and seven; same native binary as the installed Node launcher
baseline: Original complete historical R18 12/60, not tied R20 or a fresh simultaneous control
routing_constraint: Preserve user-required alphaXiv reading destinations and scholarly arXiv references
credentials: Inherited environment only; no key value or authentication file inspected
